metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 1962 · Lawrence of Arabia
metas.description: The story of T.E. Lawrence, the English officer who successfully united and led the diverse, often warring, Arab tribes during World War I in order to fight the Turks.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1965 · The Sound of Music
metas.description: A young novice is sent by her convent in 1930s Austria to become a governess to the seven children of a widowed naval officer.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1960 · Inherit the Wind
metas.description: Based on a real-life case in 1925; two great lawyers argue the case for, and against, a Tennessee science teacher accused of the crime of teaching Darwin's theory of evolution.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1969 · Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
metas.description: In 1890s Wyoming, Butch Cassidy and The Sundance Kid lead a band of outlaws. When a train robbery goes wrong, they find themselves on the run with a posse hard on their heels..

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1966 · Andrei Rublev
metas.description: The life, times and afflictions of the fifteenth-century Russian iconographer St. Andrei Rublev.
